title: PvP overall
description: Battlegrounds and world PvP. No arena and no rated ladder. One letter per spec for the job it actually does: flag, node, healer, or kill.
basis: L60 projection from beta build 1.60.1.70124 talent data plus each spec file's own PvP verdict. Seller lists are corroboration only. Nothing here was played at 60.

entries.note: The spec file's PvP call is the flag: cat burst, bear when you have to stand on it.
The battleground mage. Slows, freezes, Ice Barrier. Not a meter spec, a flag-stopper.
Mortal Strike's 50% healing cut. The spec file calls this the Warrior's PvP kit.
Opener and reset. Public lists stop at B; the kit still wins the first five seconds.
Kidney Shot plus poisons that resist dispel. The healer-killer, not the flag runner.
DoTs that keep working when you are crowd-controlled. Fear is still a battleground button.
Pet, a stun the other Hunter trees lack, and range. Holds a node without standing on it.
Melee Hunter with traps and Strider Kick. High ceiling, and it has to connect.
Silence, Blackout, and a 50% Mind Flay slow if you refuse the damage talent.
Power Word: Shield and Penance. The healer who buys a cast, not the one who tops a raid.
Lava Burst and shocks. Weak before the deep talents, a real caster once they exist.
Judgement taunts with Seal of Fury. A node tank with a blessing, not a chaser.
Concussion Blow, Shield Slam, Charge in Defensive Stance. Holds the flag room.
Best-rated mage for damage. Frost still does the peeling. Arcane is the burst window.
Death Wish and Piercing Howl, no healing cut. Play Arms if the healer is the problem.
Sprint and Riposte. Fine when you cannot restealth. Subtlety opens better.
Holy Strike and a Seal twist. Damage with a cleanse, not a dedicated killer.
Deepest buff kit and single-target heals. A node healer, not a chaser.
Stormstrike melee with a purge and an interrupt. Totems die when the fight moves.
Riptide and Earth Shock. Instant Ghost Wolf is the reposition. Totems still have to live.
Hard casts. Strong if they let you plant. Affliction wins the moment you have to move.
Aimed Shot burst. Loses the pet tools Beast Mastery brings to a node fight.
Prayer of Mending on a node. No blink. Discipline is the Priest you want focused.
HoTs and Wild Growth, no absorb, and a thinner dispel kit than the Shaman.
Ignite and Blast Wave stuns. Glass, and Frost already owns the control job.
The spec file says druids cannot snare, silence or interrupt. That is a battleground problem.
Pet variance. The spec file calls the ranking split and untested past the mid-30s.
